question: The 38th Maharashtra State Junior Athletics Championships was held in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pune**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **38th Maharashtra State Junior Athletics Championships** was held in **Pune**.
 
• **Pune** is known for hosting a variety of **sports events and championships** due to its excellent infrastructure and facilities.
 
• Pune has a rich history in **athletics and sports**, making it a suitable choice for hosting state-level competitions.
 
• The city is home to **Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex**, which is a premier venue for many major sporting events in Maharashtra.
 
• The event witnessed participation from numerous **young athletes** from across the state, competing in various athletic disciplines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nagpur**__

 __
 
• **Nagpur** is known as the **Orange City** due to its famous oranges.
 
• Nagpur is also the **winter capital of Maharashtra**.
 
• The city is an important **commercial and political center** in the Vidarbha region.
 
 
 
• **Nashik**__
 __
 
• **Nashik** is known for its **vineyards and wine production**, often referred to as the **Wine Capital of India**.
 
• The city hosts the **Kumbh Mela** every twelve years, one of the largest religious gatherings in the world.
 
• Nashik is located on the banks of the **Godavari River**.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai**__
 
 
• **Mumbai** is the **financial capital of India** and the most populous city in the country.
 
• The city is home to the **Bollywood film industry**, making it a major cultural hub.
 
• Mumbai hosts numerous **national and international sports events**, including cricket matches at the **Wankhede Stadium**.
